text:
Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Urban Concrete Circular Blue Gold White Planters
Colors: Grey
Crosshatch markes decorate the sides of these one-of-a-kind planters. Designed for succulents and air plants, these planters are perfect to decorate a table or window sill. Each planter is handmade by a local artist in northeast Indiana. 4.5" Diameter x 1.5"H Designed for small succulents and air plants Felt pads underneath prevent scratching surfaces Made by hand in the United States No additional drip tray required as the bottom is solid Since each piece is handmade expect variations
